Game Overview

In Javelin Battle, the core idea is straightforward: master the art of spear throwing in Javelin Battle, a 2D physics puzzler where strategic planning is key. Break enemy shields, prioritize threatening targets, and upgrade skills to gain the upper hand. Aim with precision, hone your tactics, and enjoy increasingly complex challenges in this engaging stickman adventure.
